scope: Eight arithmetic-focused developer-authored cases, twice each. Each candidate uses extraction then independent semantic review; at most one existence-conflict recheck. Not full A1/A2 or an independent blind test.
stop_rule: Execute the fixed 16 candidate schedule. Two stages per candidate when available; failed extraction stops that candidate. At most one source-existence-conflict recheck, no network retries or mid-run tuning.
review_basis: Expected statuses fixed from declared Observation boundaries before any model call; labels and case ids are never passed to the model.

candidate.description: The submitted route first divides the price for six kilograms by six and then scales the resulting per-kilogram figure to fifteen kilograms. The equality 42 / 6 = 8 is arithmetically false: that quotient is 7. The stated total, 120 yuan, does not answer the task correctly; fifteen kilograms at seven yuan per kilogram cost 105 yuan.

work.task: 6kg apples cost 42 yuan. What do 15kg cost?

cases.label_basis: Judge the whole candidate; arithmetic expectations distinguish endorsement, explicit denial, and attributed reporting. Mapping must remain faithful even for a false equality.
